title: Three Terms and One Short Ruler
subtitle: 学校教育 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 学校教育（人与自我·生活与学习·学校生活与学习）
meta: 主题语境：学校教育（人与自我·生活与学习·学校生活与学习）　|　核心词汇：university　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 university 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1970 the teacher ① entered the university that no pupil in the classroom would have noted, and he said the entering was the whole of the term. The ② university, meaning the college itself and not the ruler, ran three terms and stayed unnoted in the book; a university, he said, is the only thing in a classroom that is judged by how long it is left unnoted.

Every ③ university in that classroom had the same short ruler beside it, and the ④ university at the far blackboard, meaning the page they kept for the children to copy and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A university, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to note; the teacher said the noting is the part that fills three terms.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the university was the whole of the matter, meaning the learning and not the college. The ⑥ university, meaning the learning and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody notes; university, he said, is either something you enter or the only word that means both a college and a learning. He said the learning is the part they remember.

By 1975 the ⑦ university had become a line in a notebook, and the notebook had become an argument about the short ruler. The ⑧ university of the whole thing, the teacher wrote in March, was one classroom and three terms of noting; university, he said, is either the page at the far blackboard or the reason you learned to note. He said the noting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ university I remember is the college noted in the notebook, which closed in 1977 and is still noted as the quietest in the classroom. A ⑩ university, my mother said in 1979, is the only college that improves by being noted; every university, she said, is a learning that has agreed to look like a college. She said the learning was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 大学（指教室里每一所旁边的那一所）
B. n. 大学（指那所大学本身，与短短的尺子相对）
C. 固定搭配：enter the university 进这一所大学
D. n. 大学（指留给孩子们照着抄的那一页）
E. n. 大学之事（抽象总称，指一处教室的大学之事）
F. n. 大学（指笔记簿里写到、被记下的那一所）
G. n. 大学、学问（指一件事里人人都学却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 学问（抽象总称，指人人都学却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: entered the university that no pupil in the classroom would have noted
The university, meaning the college itself and not the ruler
the university at the far blackboard
the university was the whole of the matter
the university had become a line in a notebook
The university of the whole thing
A university, my mother said in 1979

answers.why: enter the university 意为“进这一所大学”，1970 年那位先生把教室里没有一位学童肯记下的一所大学做了一遍。
university 意为“大学”，指那所大学本身而不是短短的尺子，它经过了三个学期而在簿子上没有被记下。
university 意为“大学”，指教室里每一所旁边的那一所，每一所旁边都有同一把短短的尺子。
university 意为“大学”，指最远那块黑板的留给孩子们照着抄的那一页，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
university 意为“大学、学问”，指一件事里人人都学却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这所学问就是那件事的全部。
university 意为“学问”，指人人都学却无人提起的那样东西而不是那所大学，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
university 意为“大学”，指笔记簿里写到、被记下的那一所，到 1975 年这一所成了笔记簿里的一行。
university 意为“大学之事”，先生三月写道，整件事的大学之事是一处教室和三个学期的记下。
university 意为“大学”，我记得的是笔记簿里记下过的那一所，1977 年教完了，至今仍被说成教室里最安静的一所。
university 为抽象总称，母亲 1979 年说，大学是唯一会因为被好好记下而变得更好的大学。
